crossRefs.note: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were…
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness…
They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him…
Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

translations.web: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.
translations.kjv: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity
